personality_one_liner: A calm, earthy, and highly refined editorial aesthetic that lets the natural ingredients and product imagery breathe through generous whitespace and elegant typography.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Allow typography and imagery to stand out by utilizing whitespace as a primary structural tool rather than boxing everything in cards.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary or subtle brandTertiary tints for sticky elements rather than blur, maintaining the matte, earthy, editorial feel.
dont's: No glassmorphism, blur, or heavy iOS-style transparency. Keep materials grounded and paper-like.

screens.name: Storefront (Home)
screens.purpose: A minimal, magazine-like catalog of herbal and skincare products.

states.loading: Centered minimalist spinner in brand color.
states.empty: Elegant serif text 'No products available.' with a minimal botanical line-art SVG.
states.error: Serif text 'Unable to load catalog.' with a simple retry button.

screens.layout: Hero image at the top with a subtle vertical gradient scrim to ensure text readability (if text over image). Below, a horizontally scrolling row of minimal category chips (pill shape, border outline for inactive, brandPrimary fill for active). Below that, a 2-column grid of products (width: (screen - 2*padding - gap)/2). Cards have 0 radius, large image (aspect ratio 4:5), with small sans-serif title and price underneath. No heavy shadows or borders around cards.

screens.name: Product Detail
screens.purpose: Showcase the product with high-quality imagery and clean typography.
screens.layout: Full-width product image at the top (no safe area top margin on the image to make it edge-to-edge). Beneath the image, large display serif title and sans-serif price. Generous vertical whitespace. Body text for description. Sticky 'Add to Cart' button at the bottom of the screen (anchored in a surface/surfaceSecondary container with safe area bottom padding).

screens.name: Cart & Checkout
screens.purpose: Review items and collect guest checkout details for Razorpay.

states.empty: Empty cart botanical illustration + 'Your cart is empty' in serif.
states.error: Payment failed or validation error message.

screens.layout: List of cart items separated by a 1pt divider. Each item has a square thumbnail, title, price, and minimalist +/- quantity controls. Below the items, subtotal and total breakdown. If checking out, a single-column form (name, email, phone, address) with labels above inputs (sans-serif, muted). Sticky 'Pay with Razorpay' primary CTA pinned to the bottom.

screens.name: Order Success
screens.layout: Centered layout with a botanical checkmark or elegant illustration. Large serif 'Thank You'. Order number and summary below in sans-serif. 'Continue Shopping' secondary button.

screens.name: Admin Panel
screens.layout: A list view of products with edit/delete swipe actions or small text buttons. A 'floating' or sticky 'Add Product' button. Add/Edit screen is a clean single-column form with text inputs for Name, Description, Price, Category, Stock, and Image URL.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design Identity: Strictly adhere to the '3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT' personality. The app should feel like a premium, minimal, calm magazine. No heavy shadows, no rounded UI, no glassmorphism.
Color Palette: Use the warm paper-white (surface) and muted sage green (brand). Text should be deep charcoal/forest green, never pure black.
Typography: Use CormorantGaramond for all headings (Store name, Product titles, section headers) and DMSans for body text, prices, and labels. Do not use weights above 500.
Layout Rules: Avoid boxing content into cards. Let products breathe on the surface. For the product grid, use a 2-column layout with 0 radius on the images and text directly underneath.
Sticky Actions: 'Add to Cart' and 'Pay with Razorpay' MUST be sticky at the bottom of their respective screens, above the safe area, never inline with scrolling content.
Images: Ensure any text overlaid on the hero image utilizes a linear-gradient scrim (top-to-bottom, transparent to surfaceInverse) to guarantee WCAG contrast.
Admin access: Since there's no auth, place a discreet 'Admin' tab in the bottom tab bar, or a settings cog on the home screen to access the Admin Panel.
Cart & Checkout: Combine the cart review and guest checkout form into one smooth flow or stacked screens. Inputs should be minimal (hairline borders, labels above).
